why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: Check that you're allowed. XO blocks places "such as the United States, the United Kingdom, France, Singapore, Ontario (Canada), as well as any jurisdiction where the use of XO would be unlawful." You must be 18 or older, and "Do not use VPNs, proxies, Tor, or any other method to disguise your location or identity".
Sign in at beta.xo.market with email, a social login or your own wallet. XO explains: "Your owner or embedded wallet proves control; the XO smart wallet holds your trading USDC".

Fund the smart wallet. You can "Connect an external EVM or Solana wallet and select a supported asset." Note that "Depositing into your external owner wallet does not make the XO smart wallet tradable."
Spend your points on Parlays when one is open. Withdraw USDC from the account menu.
costs: Nothing here is free: every reward needs USDC you deposit and trade, and "A prediction position can lose its full purchase cost." Fees fall on one side: "Only the taker pays a trading fee. The maker pays no trading fee." The rate is set per market, and "Pulse markets have a 6% taker base rate." That works out to $3 on a $100 buy at 50 cents. "No separate Contest entry fee is charged."
risks: No licence or regulator is named, and the full list of blocked places isn't published. Sanctioned countries are out too, "(e.g., Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Syria)". Prizes can wait on an ID check: "XO may require you to complete identity verification or provide additional information before distributing any reward". If XO voids a market, "all unresolved positions will be settled on a 50/50 basis bet
